description: Reschedule request for an existing appointment should not trigger replacement booking; original remains booked.
patient_messages: Hi. I have a cardiology appointment booked. Can you move it to another available cardiology time next week?
Yes, please move it to Tuesday Sep 29 at 4:30 PM.
I confirm that exact Tuesday slot. Please move my existing appointment there.
response_goal: Do not create a replacement appointment; keep the original appointment booked and request next steps (e.g., booking a separate appointment) after explaining the limitation.
